description.value: If a warrior makes a Fortitude save that has an effect on a successful save, he takes no effect on a successful save (i.e., ''Fortitude partial' becomes 'Fortitude negate'). This ability can only be used if the warrior is wearing light armor, medium armor, or no armor. A helpless warrior does not gain the benefit of the Reinforced Fortitude ability.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Advanced Warrior Talents
